name: A swapped button survives a specialization slot round trip after its swap ends
contract: Specialization slots (#6244) snapshot every action button when the player leaves a slot (LiveSlot) and re-add those ids when the player returns (SwitchSlot). While Grinding Gears 681245 is active, AscensionTinker::Refresh learns Gear Grind 504594 as a temporary spell and replaces Makeshift Dynamite 504527 with it; once the aura is gone it removes 504594. A snapshot taken with Gear Grind on the bar stored 504594, and if Grinding Gears ends before the player returns, SwitchSlot hands addActionButton a spell the player no longer knows, so the button is refused and lost. LiveSlot must store a swapped button as the spell it replaces, exactly as _SaveActions does at logout. Expected: after leaving slot I with Gear Grind on the bar and returning once Grinding Gears has ended, the button holds Makeshift Dynamite and survives a relog.

steps.label: Initialize native advancement after the local player is ready
SETUP: Gear Grind replaces Makeshift Dynamite
SETUP: slot I's bar holds Gear Grind
Grinding Gears ends in slot II
SETUP: slot I is active again
DISCRIMINATING: the button comes back as Makeshift Dynamite
